title: Heidenhain DIN/ISO post writes FUNCTION DWELL, which no iTNC 530 accepts; write G04 F

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

`assets/posts/heidenhain.cps:759` writes `FUNCTION DWELL TIME<s>` (with no space before the value, for example `FUNCTION DWELL TIME0.5`). The block appears for ream and back-bore dwells and for peck drilling with a dwell.

## Why it is wrong

HEIDENHAIN's own "New functions" lists show when `FUNCTION DWELL` arrived:

- TNC 640: NC software 34059x-07
- TNC 620: 81760x-04
- TNC 320: 77185x-04
- TNC 128: 77184x-05
- TNC7: all versions
- **iTNC 530: no version has it.**

Sources: the HEIDENHAIN "Overview of New and Modified Software Functions" documents 1322095-02 (p. 65) and 1322094-03 (p. 48), and user's manual 819494-24 (p. 14).

The iTNC 530 dwell is cycle 9 DWELL TIME (DIN/ISO `G04 F<seconds>`). An iTNC 530 control refuses the block. The control gives an alarm. There is no motion. The Fehlmann Picomax 55 machine file states iTNC 530 NC 340490-03.

## Expected

- For an iTNC 530 (and any control before the versions above), write `G04 F<seconds>`.
- Where `FUNCTION DWELL` is valid, write the documented form, with a space before the value (check the syntax in the manual).
- The choice follows the control and NC software in the machine file (see the dialect issue filed with this one).

## Done means

- A ream with a dwell posts `G04 F..` for an iTNC 530 machine.
- A test pins both forms.
- The existing goldens change only where they contain the dwell block. Each change is listed in the PR.

Related: #3095 (DIN/ISO output not yet run on a real iTNC 530).
